mapper.sql: CASE WHEN ${alias}reservation_status IN ('overdue_holding','disputed_holding') OR (${alias}reservation_status='renting' AND ${alias}rental_end_date<#{today}) THEN CAST('9999-12-31' AS DATE) ELSE ${alias}occupy_end_date END

(SELECT FROM inventory_reservation UNION ALL SELECT h.origin_reservation_id AS id,h.sku_id,h.sn_id,h.quantity,h.checkout_batch_id,h.checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id,h.rental_order_id,h.rental_order_item_id,h.source_type,h.source_id,h.rental_start_date,h.rental_end_date,h.occupy_start_date,h.occupy_end_date,h.reservation_status,h.expires_at,h.idempotency_key,h.version,h.created_at,h.updated_at FROM inventory_reservation_history h WHERE NOT EXISTS(SELECT 1 FROM inventory_reservation r WHERE r.id=h.origin_reservation_id))

choose.when: SELECT FROM inventory_reservation WHERE id=#{id} FOR UPDATE

mapper.update: UPDATE inventory_reservation SET reservation_status='paid_locked',rental_order_id=#{orderId},rental_order_item_id=#{orderItemId},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE checkout_batch_id=#{batchId} AND checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id=#{snapshotId} AND reservation_status='held'
UPDATE inventory_reservation SET reservation_status=#{status},version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE checkout_batch_id=#{batchId} AND reservation_status='held'
UPDATE inventory_reservation SET reservation_status='released',version=version+1,updated_at=#{now} WHERE rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND reservation_status='paid_locked'
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO inventory_reservation_history(id,sku_id,sn_id,quantity,checkout_batch_id,checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id,rental_order_id,rental_order_item_id,source_type,source_id,rental_start_date,rental_end_date,occupy_start_date,occupy_end_date,reservation_status,expires_at,idempotency_key,version,created_at,updated_at,origin_reservation_id,archive_batch_no,archived_at) SELECT #{id},sku_id,sn_id,quantity,checkout_batch_id,checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id,rental_order_id,rental_order_item_id,source_type,source_id,rental_start_date,rental_end_date,occupy_start_date,occupy_end_date,reservation_status,expires_at,idempotency_key,version,created_at,updated_at,id,#{batch},#{now} FROM inventory_reservation WHERE id=#{origin}
mapper.select: SELECT origin_reservation_id AS id,sku_id,sn_id,quantity,checkout_batch_id,checkout_batch_item_snapshot_id,rental_order_id,rental_order_item_id,source_type,source_id,rental_start_date,rental_end_date,occupy_start_date,occupy_end_date,reservation_status,expires_at,idempotency_key,version,created_at,updated_at FROM inventory_reservation_history WHERE origin_reservation_id=#{origin}
mapper.delete: DELETE FROM inventory_reservation WHERE id=#{id} AND version=#{version} AND reservation_status IN ('released','expired','cancelled','completed')
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.occupy_start_date, r.quantity, r.rental_order_id, r.rental_order_item_id, r.reservation_status, r.sku_id, r.sn_id FROM r WHERE r.rental_order_id=#{orderId} AND NOT(r.source_type <=> 'extension_request') ORDER BY r.sku_id,r.sn_id,r.id
SELECT FROM inventory_reservation WHERE checkout_batch_id=#{id} ORDER BY sku_id,sn_id,id
